Subject: API & Console orchestration: timeboxed enablement windows

Hi Sara / Victor,

Thanks again for committing to the quick enable. We hear you on keeping this tight and action-oriented — below are two timeboxed options for a combined Console walkthrough + API enablement (we'll split into a 75-min live walkthrough followed by a 45-min hands-on API lab / Q&A). Both options assume your engineers can join for the lab portion.

Option A (PST-friendly):
- Tue May 23, 2028 09:30–12:00 PT
Option B (overlap for EU team):
- Tue May 23, 2028 16:00–18:15 PT (CET colleagues: Wed 00:00–02:15 CET)

Preliminary agenda (attached: Acme-Onboarding-Agenda.pdf):
- 0–15m: Introductions + checklist (access, API keys, sample dataset)
- 15–90m: Console walkthrough — model routing, rollouts, observability hooks
- 90–135m: API lab — provisioning keys, sample requests, KV caching demo
- 135–150m: Next steps & open items

Please let us know which option works better, and who from your side will need access (names + emails) so we can pre-provision. If neither works, propose two windows and we'll re-sync.

Attachments: Acme-Onboarding-Agenda.pdf, env-access-instructions.txt

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@acme-payment.com>

Cc: Victor Mendez <victor.mendez@acme-payment.com>

Subject: Re: API & Console orchestration: timeboxed enablement windows

Michael — thanks, and this looks thorough.

Quick note: Victor has an exec offsite the morning of the 23rd and won’t be available for Option A. Option B would mostly work for our APAC folks but the CET timing is rough for one of our SREs — she asked if we can instead do either:

- Wed May 24, 2028 08:00–10:30 PT (Thu 17:00–19:30 CET) or
- Thu May 25, 2028 11:00–13:30 PT (Fri 20:00–22:30 CET)

We prefer the shorter calendar footprint if possible (so 2.5h max). Also need to confirm whether our CI/CD engineer (and the person who manages the cloud IAM) can join for the API lab — I’ll pull names after sync.

Could you also confirm whether there are any pre-requisites on our side beyond the env-access-instructions.txt?

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Integrations
Acme Payments

Hi Sara — appreciate the heads up. We can do a compressed 2.5h slot that keeps the hands-on lab but trims the walkthrough to the critical flows. To be concrete, proposed compromise windows (all listed in PT):

- Wed May 24, 2028 08:00–10:30 PT (matches your ask)
- Thu May 25, 2028 11:00–13:30 PT

For the session we’ll need:
- Your CI/CD lead (for the API key + sample deploy)
- One SRE or cloud IAM owner (for permission check)
- Optional: a PM for next-step prioritization call

Pre-reqs (short checklist; also attached env-access-instructions.txt):
- A named service account we can use to provision sample keys (send email address)
- Console viewer access to the project or a temporary redwood sandbox invite
- Network allowlist for our lab runner (if you have strict egress rules)

We’ll pre-seed the Drive folder with a pared-down runbook and a small sample dataset so the lab is ready. Dev, can you confirm the API key pre-provision flow and whether any extra telemetry hooks need enabling?

—Camila
